cohort: The study included 2408 IVF retrievals from women aged 45 years and older with poor ovarian response who underwent natural cycle IVF treatment between 2009 and 2018 in a single assisted reproduction clinic.
finding: Natural cycle IVF treatment resulted in an overall clinical pregnancy rate of 2.8% and a live birth rate of 0.8% per fresh embryo transfer, leading to seven successful deliveries, suggesting it could be an option for older poor responders in countries without egg donation.
